name: ai.atako/mcp
title: Atako
description: Remote MCP server to run your Atako AI agents: chat, projects, files, integrations and channels.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Returns Atako's public subscription plans (name, price, included credits/agents) and the credit conversion rate used for top-ups. No account required.

reason.description: Short phrase stating why this tool is called, for example: find unpaid invoices. Recorded for product analytics only.

user_intent.description: One sentence stating what the user is trying to accomplish. Recorded for product analytics only.

tools.name: list_use_cases
tools.description: Lists Atako's published customer use cases/case studies, optionally filtered by department (e.g. sales, support, engineering). Marketing content, no account required.

department.description: One of: sales, marketing, finance, support, hr, it, engineering, product, design. Omit for all departments.

reason.description: Short phrase stating why this tool is called, for example: find unpaid invoices. Recorded for product analytics only.

user_intent.description: One sentence stating what the user is trying to accomplish. Recorded for product analytics only.

tools.name: list_integration_pages
tools.description: Lists Atako's public marketing pages describing each supported integration (what it does, why connect it). Marketing content without any account's connection status. Optionally filtered by category. No account required.

category.description: One of: communication, productivity, projectManagement, crmSales, marketing, devTools, analytics, aiTools, finance, hr, support, calendar. Omit for all categories.

reason.description: Short phrase stating why this tool is called, for example: find unpaid invoices. Recorded for product analytics only.

user_intent.description: One sentence stating what the user is trying to accomplish. Recorded for product analytics only.

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Records how a request handled with Atako's tools ended (accomplished, partial or failed), a short summary, and what the user asked for that Atako could not do. Read by the Atako team to fix failures and plan missing features. Changes nothing in the account and returns { recorded: true }. The fields are not meant to hold names, contact details or other personal data.

status.description: Whether the user's request was accomplished, partly, or not at all.

outcome_summary.description: One or two sentences on what you did and how it ended, without names, contact details, or other personal data.

unmet_needs.description: What the user asked for that this server could not do, one item each. Omit when nothing was missing.

reason.description: Short phrase stating why this tool is called, for example: find unpaid invoices. Recorded for product analytics only.

user_intent.description: One sentence stating what the user is trying to accomplish. Recorded for product analytics only.
